notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.54 — Fix incorrect red attendance markers on the sidebar Induction Calendar introduced by v1.1.53. Future MBL bookings are never treated as overdue attendance; the current day's attendance is due only from the noon check, and older dates show red only for actual unchecked attendance. Replaced overlapping red number bubbles with tiny discreet red dots for past-due attendance and neutral grey dots for upcoming bookings; hover displays exact counts. Corrected day summary to recognise confirmed official Attended/Not Attended outcomes and saved YES/NO records for that same date. All attendance data, official MBL sync verification, recorded history, pending official review cases and candidate bookings are unchanged. Added regression tests for future, before-noon, after-noon and prior-day calendar indicators.
